question: Why would even unrivaled prosperity fail to remove Arjuna's grief?
premises: Arjuna sees no remedy for his grief
Even unrivaled earthly kingdom would not suffice
Even lordship over gods would not suffice
inference: His sorrow is not cured by external power
uncertainties: fused optative form is corrupt or abbreviated
plain_english: I do not see what would remove my grief, even obtaining an unrivaled prosperous kingdom on earth or lordship even over the gods.
